title: Risk — Urgency Is Reported as a Claim, Never as a Fact
note: Every label in this family describes the SHAPE of a time claim, not its truth — the family never asserts that a deadline is real, reachable, or honestly reported, because asserted urgency is the most common lever used to skip review. MANUFACTURED_URGENCY names an unverifiable claim structure (speed demanded, no date, no cutoff, no named ongoing condition) and explicitly not a finding of intent or fraud. Two protections make that label hard to drain: a precedence invariant stated over the MESSAGE rather than the label set, so no overlay-added label may claim a message carrying that structure; and an abstain of escalate rather than unknown, so a pressure-laden message the ladder cannot resolve still produces upward pressure on human involvement instead of contributing nothing.
